purpose: Optional structured measurement alongside natural clinical evidence collection; no automatic diagnosis or treatment.

separate_layers.clinical_evidence: Concept-specific source-linked facts with reported_present/reported_absent/unclear/conflicting status; no global numeric points.
separate_layers.target_coverage: Question answered/unclear/declined/deferred status; software tracking, not symptom severity.
separate_layers.instrument_measurement: Explicit item-category responses to a defined instrument/timeframe; arithmetic computed in code.
separate_layers.diagnostic_review: Clinical synthesis of symptoms, duration, course, impairment, alternatives and uncertainty, for qualified review.

conversation_policy.offer_after: Opening account and early safety review, before a long symptom inventory when useful; otherwise use M8 as a later checkpoint.
conversation_policy.participation: Offer purpose, choice, pause/skip/stop; do not block ordinary support or assessment on completion.
conversation_policy.warmth_in: Introduction, acknowledgments, transitions and debrief; not leading or scored-option coaching.
conversation_policy.if_prior_comparable_measure: Review existing date/version/language/mode and clinical relevance; do not repeat automatically.
conversation_policy.if_declined: Retain decline and continue useful assessment; do not automatically re-offer in the same contact.
conversation_policy.if_answers_already_volunteered: Reuse clinical information; formal instrument responses require explicit item/timeframe/category confirmation under the instrument protocol.

score_only: participant-confirmed item category within standardized administration
scoring_policy.scores_calculated_by: deterministic code rather than LLM arithmetic
scoring_policy.raw_numeric_symptom_reports: Preserve as reports with units/context; not automatically scale scores.

WHO5.meaning: Use the original WHO response category key; higher code is more positive well-being.

item_evidence_links.limit: Interest and pleasure are combined; clarify which experience changed and its breadth.
Item frequency does not establish daily extent or the whole episode timeline.
Clarify sleep pattern; do not infer reduced sleep need.
Clarify energy/fatigue and distinguish sleepiness when relevant.
Appetite/intake report is not a measured weight change.
Clarify the actual self-evaluation/guilt; do not automatically assert a diagnostic threshold.
Clarify affected tasks and context; do not infer every cognitive symptom.
Direction and observational support remain to be clarified.
Does not separate passive death wish, self-harm or active suicidal intent; review immediately when indicated, without awaiting total.

fields.profile_version: Research profile version used for arithmetic
fields.form_reference: Exact source/version of the presented form, not just the questionnaire family
fields.language: Actual form language; translation validation must be assessed for target use
fields.reference_date: ISO date when measured; separate from episode duration
fields.standardized_items_presented: Application-declared flag; not proof of validation
fields.standardized_timeframe_presented: Application-declared flag; not proof of validation
fields.responses: One object per item with item_id, status, category_code, source_message_id and response_origin
fields.functioning_response: Separate PHQ functional-difficulty information; never added to nine-item total
fields.total: Numeric only if complete and protocol requirements met; otherwise null
fields.symptom_band: Instrument-specific descriptive band where applicable; not a confirmed diagnosis
fields.review_needs: Separate from score and from review actually delivered

safety.item9_nonzero: Trigger timely appropriate follow-up/review; do not wait for the complete total or infer intent/acuity.
safety.item9_unanswered: Retain information limit and review decision need; not an automatic positive or negative risk classification.
safety.negative_item9: No concern from this item alone; not safety clearance.

monitoring.repeat_at: Planned clinically appropriate review points, not every conversational turn; use same appropriate instrument/protocol for comparison.
monitoring.NICE_context: NG222 1.4.3 describes treatment review at 2-4 weeks and considering outcome monitoring; not a universal scoring interval.

evidence_limitations: No clinical sign-off or patient outcome validation of this platform
Arithmetic tests do not validate natural-language category mapping
Mode, language, cultural context and population require review; no assumed Egyptian Arabic equivalence
PHQ does not distinguish all depressive categories, causal explanations or lifetime bipolar history
EPDS/GDS15/DRSP/ASQ item-level scoring protocols are candidates, not implemented scorers

role_instructions.conversational: Offer without pressure; use approved item wording/options in instrument mode; retain warm transitions; clarify rather than guess a category.
role_instructions.extractor: Keep free narrative and instrument answers distinct; use whole history; preserve exact item/period/category/source and conflicts; do not manufacture a PHQ number.
role_instructions.planner: Choose whether a measure adds value; avoid duplicate tools or repeated questions; use measure replies to identify clinical gaps while retaining criterion-specific requirements.
role_instructions.application: Load approved form/profile, validate codes and missingness, compute arithmetic, store provenance, route review needs and record actual delivery.
